slice: Outer districts + coffee + bars + dessert. SEPARATE from CREATORS_HCMC.json.
note: WebSearch-only research from a US region: I could not reliably surface individual Vietnamese TikTok/YouTube/IG food vloggers with a *findable* verified clip on each specific place, so — per the honesty rule — I did NOT invent creator attributions or follower counts. The vetted independent creator-authored sources below each count as ONE corroborating source (never an authority); institutional gates (MICHELIN, Asia's 50 Best Bars, World's 50 Best) carry the lone-authority entries. A follow-up local-language pass (YouTube/TikTok in Vietnamese) is the way to add named vloggers with follower scale.

creators.name: Vietnam Coracle (Tom Divers)
creators.followers: top independent Vietnam travel resource; word-of-mouth, no sponsors, 400+ guides since 2005
creators.verified: Named, long-form Saigon chè guide covering Chè Hà Ký & Chè Kỳ Đồng.

creators.name: Will Fly for Food (JB & Renée Macatulad)
creators.followers: established travel-food blog with sizeable audience (not re-measured this pass)
creators.verified: First-person Vĩnh Khánh (District 4) seafood-street guide naming Ốc Oanh / Ốc Đào.

creators.name: Rusty Compass (Mark Bowyer)
creators.verified: Authored district, coffee and nightlife reviews (Cholon, District 2, Vĩnh Khánh, Layla, cafes).

creators.name: Daniel Food Diary
creators.verified: Named Cộng Cà Phê / coconut-coffee piece.
